subject: Request: short trial extension while PO routes (MediSync)
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@medisync.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medisync.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — pilot extension while PO routes

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well. We’re almost across the finish line internally — legal has a small routing question and procurement is moving the PO through three approvers. Finance estimates final sign-off in ~6 business days.

The pilot is in the middle of user testing and we’re worried the timer will expire before the PO lands. Can Redwood provide a short extension (7–10 days) or a small token credit to keep the environment active while procurement completes? We don’t want to lose momentum with the clinical team.

I attached a draft PO for reference. Happy to provide any internal routing contacts if that helps.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Ellis
Head of Product Operations
MediSync Health
Attachments: medisync_po_draft_0412.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@medisync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot extension while PO routes

Hi Tom — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

We can absolutely help avoid a pause. Two options we can offer while procurement finalizes:
- 7-day automatic trial extension (no action required) OR
- 5,000 free token credit applied to the account to keep tests running for you and the clinical team.

To proceed I just need an estimated PO clearance date and the HubSpot deal id (or the PO number once it’s issued). I’ve looped in Ben (sales) and Grace (CS) to align on the conditional approval and to document the extension in the account.

I’m attaching our standard trial-terms stub — extension is contingent on PO issuance within the agreed window.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: trial-terms-Redwood-2028-04.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@medisync.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot extension while PO routes

Thanks Neha. Agree we should keep the pilot live — loss of momentum is the riskiest thing. Ben from Sales here.

Approved to provide a bridged allowance: we’ll credit 5,000 free tokens immediately and extend the trial window by 7 days as a safety net. Condition: PO is expected within 10 business days from today; if the PO doesn’t arrive we’ll reevaluate with your team.

Tom — can you confirm HubSpot deal id or provide the internal PO number once available? I’ll add the credit line and log the conditional approval under deal RDW-8342.

Next steps (from Redwood):
• Apply 5,000 token credit to the account within 24 hours.
• Grant a 7-day timer extension now; if you need longer and procurement confirms a longer ETA we can revisit.

Ben Carter
Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@medisync.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medisync.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot extension while PO routes

Thanks Ben and Neha — really appreciate the fast help. I’ve uploaded the PO draft and shared with procurement; they say the earliest realistic clearance is 6 business days but there’s a non-zero chance it slips to 9–10.

HubSpot deal id is HS-55612. I’m attaching the PO draft again for your records. If possible can we move the safety net to a 10-day extension instead of 7? That would cover the upper bound of routing risk and reduce follow-ups on our side. If not, the token credit will do and we’ll prioritize the PO.

Tom
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@medisync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot extension while PO routes

Tom — thanks for the update and for confirming HS-55612.

We’ll do the following to keep things moving:
1) Apply the 5,000 free token credit now (you should see it in the account within a couple hours).
2) Extend the trial timer by 10 days (one-time exception given the procurement risk).
3) This is conditional on receipt of the PO within the 10-day window; if it goes past that we’ll pause and reconnect.

Ben/Grace — I’ve logged the conditional approval under RDW-8342 in HubSpot and attached the PO draft to the deal notes. Grace, please follow up on onboarding tasks once the PO clears.

Tom — let me know if you need anything else. Good luck with the routing.

Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
